title: 2020 Kia Sonet - Kia's next big thing | First Look | Autocar India
description: The Kia Sonet compact SUV is coming soon to take on the Hyundai Venue, Tata Nexon, Maruti Suzuki Vitara Brezza, Mahindra XUV300 and Ford EcoSport. Renuka Kirpalani gives you a first look at the production-spec Sonet. Expect Kia Sonet prices to range from Rs 6.5-12 lakh (ex-showroom) when it goes on sale in September 2020.   Do subscribe to our sister channel What Car? asr.full_text: so what I have here with me today is the Road Ready version of the kia Sonnet we saw the concept earlier this year at the auteu expo and looking, it looks really true to concept. I'm going to walk around this compact suv, what we have here is the GT line so top-end version of the car. Let's take a look at all the details on the exterior beginning with the headlamps, which have that heartbeat and they like to call this the Crown Jewel headlamps because on the inside on the DRL's, It has a lot of the lines which give it a sort of a nice look, jeweled look. There is a flat area contoured under the headlamps. That gives it a lot of light play, below the fog housings were earlier all black in the concept but now we got this chrome look for the fog lamps. Going along the bottom of very very strong large air dam. That curls up towards the end in sort of a plastic chrome look, strong skid plate underneath and of course there is that tiger nose grill that we're very very familiar with surrounded by this knurled chrome, as we've seen in the Celtos and the glossy black for the grille. So, a nice strong muscular front. Let's come around the sides. 16-inch alloys on the side, nice strong wheel arches, which give it the very SUV kind of look. Large amount of ground clearance. Looks pretty nice and high off the ground, chrome area along the window line glossy black that forms the top part of the window line and of course the roof rails over here. Now coming to the C pillar is a very interesting area you have the quarter glass that's kind of angled, the glossy black off the top of the window line meets this paint strip which kind of wraps itself the glossy black at the top of the window line meets this paint strip which kind of wraps itself around the rear, and of course there is a glossy black which extends into the rear windscreen and makes it look large, wide and wrapped around. Of course you have the LED DRL tail lamps at the back which continue that heartbeat theme. They're connected by a reflector strip in the middle, nice flattish area for the tailgate, you've got skid plates here underneath as well, these ones are in the glossy black again, a little chrome look for the dual exhausts but they're there just for show. They're not really the exhaust at the back that's just for appearances. Let's take a look at the boot. You could get a couple of suitcases in here really nicely and easily and for this size of a car I think I have to say that this boot looks nice large-sized. We don't know its exact volume just yet, but we'll have to find that out We'll get inside and take a look inside, shall we? So starting from the back seat, well, for the size of car that it is, SUV I'd have to say, a reasonable amount of legroom here. I've sort of set the seat position for a six footer in front. So behind a six footer, I've got enough and ample space and even someone taller will have a lot of leg room over here. Floorboard is quite slattish with just a little bit of a central tunnel. So yes, you can fit a third person in here. The seat base is also quite flat, good enough to fit the third person. I have an armrest with cup holders. I have dual AC vents, there's the air purifier which has the indicator here at the back, a nice slot for a phone, there's a charging point too at the rear. So yes, quite well equipped in the rear seat as well. There is also a sunroof. Yes, you do get a sunroof with this car. So a small little sunroof for the front area. Lets get in and take a look at the dashboard and what the front seats feel like. Okay so getting into the front, you know, we are used to this from Kia now, good top notch quality, soft plastic for the top area of the dash, it's got texture it looks really nice, large chunky air vents, I am not not sure I like the 2 over here in the centre, they look really really large... But you've got the 10.25 inch which is a really good size for this car... Touchscreen infotainment system sort of looks like a single screen, that leads into the glossy black for the binnacle area... Digital dials with read-outs over there, 3 spoke steering with all the controls, it's a nice sporty steering for this GT-line you've got a wireless charging pad on top, storage area for a phone underneath, 12V socket, USB charger, USB for your Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, you've got the Auto gear lever over here because this is the auto version, nice matte chrome surround for this with that nirled look, little things that really highlight this cabin, make it very-very rich, you've got a Bose 7 speaker system which is really good as well, really has all the bells and whistles with nice comfortable contoured seats with the sides that kind of hold you in. Yeah, this feels really really good! Let's take a closer look at the infotainment screen and see what all can be accessed. So, a lot of features over here. You have the YuvoConnect app as well and you have the UVO CONNECT® APP as well and you have NAV, you have Android Auto, Apple Car Play, there is voice recognition, for this car as well. You have the drive modes as well, like we've seen in the Seltos, so you have Normal, Eco and Sport and then of course you have the traction ones, which are also Snow, Mud and Sand. So yes, this car comes really well equipped. Now lets Recap all the features I spoke of and take a look at the safety features too. So, you can expect the Kia Sonet to come with a 1.0-litre turbo petrol, a 1.2-litre petrol and a 1.5-litre diesel, they will come mated to manual and automatic transmissions. You will get the DCT as well but what you will get this time around is the intelligent manual transmission too. What does that mean? Well, you will have a manual gear lever, you just won't have the clutch pedal pedal the car's electronics will operate that for you well looking at it sexy strong striking and feature-packed here's another car from Kia that is going to Wow customers in the market middle of September.
